story.title: Capture contact preferences
story.description:
As a customer I want to choose how the company contacts me.

Figma Design Link: Contact preferences
story.acceptanceCriteria:
• The page shows the contact preferences form per the design: stepper, header, four Yes/No toggles (email, SMS, phone, post), Save button
  • All labels, titles and subtitles shown in EN and AR per the copy table
  • Save persists the choices, shows a success toast in the active language, and moves the customer to Step 6
  • Email reminder field: empty value, special characters, and leading/trailing spaces show the inline error in the active language
  • SMS opt-in verification is handled separately (out of scope for this story)
